计算与读取运动指标；保留零值、缺失、冲突、分母不足的区别。

layout.init_policy: Empty package markers; root molvid/__init__.py may define __version__. No eager re-exports, PVB aliases, old-package import shims or sys.path patches.

packaging.install_policy: Use the existing project environment. Configure flat package discovery explicitly; do not install or upgrade third-party dependencies without authorization.
packaging.smoke_check: After installing the project into the existing environment, import molvid from a directory outside the repository and check its resolved file path.

data_locations.training_data: external NAS/data disk, located through configuration
data_locations.policy: Do not move, rewrite, delete or package the existing training data/checkpoints. datasets/ is optional, ignored by Git, and is not an additional Python package. Do not create a symlink automatically.

directory_policies.role: Captured small numerical references; no copied training corpus or large checkpoint.
Optional local data location/symlink; external data remains the default.
Generated evaluation/profile outputs and large reference artifacts; not package content.

root_file_roles.pyproject.toml: Explicitly discover only the root molvid package; testpaths points to tests; no src package-dir mapping.
root_file_roles..gitignore: Ignore local datasets/ and generated outputs; keep tiny tests/fixtures trackable; do not untrack existing evidence indiscriminately.
root_file_roles.docs/migration.md: One compact current migration record: actual HEAD, resolved symbols, phase, commands/results, key mapping, blockers and next step. Reuse it rather than proliferating new PLAN/HANDOFF files.
root_file_roles.README.md: Current import/CLI examples and external data locations; primary usage no longer describes the old PVB workflow.
root_file_roles.experiments/architecture_20260914/round3: Historical protocol/evidence only if its retired refiner is required. Reproduce the retired algorithm at the old commit, not by reintroducing it into the new package.

execution.default_mode: one writer, sequential dependency groups, independent review
execution.continuation: Continue to the next phase after its checks pass; do not seek confirmation for routine moves. Stop only the dependent work for unresolved scientific differences or unavailable mandatory resources.
rules: Use an isolated worktree based on the actual checked-out HEAD. Preserve uncommitted changes; do not reset, force-push, or modify the remote.
All Python, tests and numerical commands run through the existing enter-container / torch-ito environment. Do not reinstall dependencies to hide an import failure.
Perform source inspection and symbol extraction before rewriting tests; migrate useful assertions instead of deleting failing tests or weakening tolerances.
Migrate one dependency group at a time. Finish its targeted checks and a recoverable local checkpoint before the next group; do not launch whole-repository rewrites in parallel.
Default to one integration owner. Other sessions may read/review; parallel writes are only for explicitly non-overlapping, dependency-stable work.
The old worktree/reference commit remains the oracle until final cutover. New production modules never import old module/trainer/scripts; compare old and new in separate processes.
Keep the original plan names/classes as responsibilities, not a license to create empty stubs or new model behavior. Log real interface conflicts in docs/migration.md.
New interfaces may use inputs that exist at inference (topology, timestamps, masks and observed coordinates); future coordinates must not enter conditions, graph caches or rollout state.
Do not alter model formulae, tensor semantics, vocabulary IDs, training data, loss reduction, RNG draw order, frozen modules or sampling strategy as part of this refactor.
No long training or full historical study reruns by default. Use existing tiny/3-system fixtures and short CUDA parity checks.
Retirement entries are candidates, not deletion commands. Delete only after retained callers, configuration dispatch, tests, artifacts and useful helpers have been checked.
If required CUDA/data/checkpoints are unavailable, mark the dependent numerical checks as not_run and hold the dependent cutover/deletion. Continue only independent, verifiable work.

phases.title: 核对基线和迁移边界
tasks: Record git HEAD/branch/dirty state, environment and retained entrypoints; compare actual HEAD against the design baseline instead of rolling back automatically.
Resolve actual source symbols and dynamic/config-driven callers for each target file; classify unused imports separately from runtime dependencies.
Record one working codec and DiT configuration, checkpoint/statistics identities and RNG states; capture old-path tiny forward/loss/gradient/update/resume references when resources are available.
Create/update only the compact docs/migration.md record; no production renaming or deletion in this phase.
acceptance: Actual source/target mapping and retained call paths recorded.
Reference commands and availability recorded; missing resources are not marked as passed.

phases.title: 浅层包、数据与几何基础
tasks: Create flat molvid/ package markers and explicit package discovery; no src/ or models/ wrapper.
Migrate data structures, stores, sampling, geometry and the two shared equivariant operators; preserve current storage bytes and type IDs.
acceptance: Targeted data/geometry tests preserve existing assertions.
New foundational imports do not load old packages.
Tiny static and trajectory records retain units, atom ordering, masks and per-sample boundaries.

phases.title: 空间编码器、codec 与权重映射
tasks: Extract FrameEncoder/TorchMDEncoder and compose TrajectoryCodec without legacy bridge logic.
Move coordinate_head ownership explicitly and migrate checkpoint keys without reinitializing retained weights.
Preserve effective initialization/RNG order and shared-parameter identity; record any removed unreachable parameter/buffer separately.
acceptance: Compare old/new frame features, Haar/codec latents and decoded coordinates using the same weights and input.
No missing target weights, duplicate key collisions or silent strict=False fallback for required weights.
Codec reconstruction loss and gradients match the reference within pre-established dtype/device tolerances.

phases.title: latent、DiT 和 flow
tasks: Migrate adapter/types/statistics/conditioning and both DiT execution backends.
Separate flow objective/source/sampling; preserve observation masks, source gauge, clean target and online noise semantics.
acceptance: Same input weights/tau/noise produce equivalent DiT velocity and flow loss.
Reference/optimized forward and gradients agree as in the baseline.
Changing true future coordinates cannot change inference conditions; corrupted observations do not overwrite clean future targets.

phases.title: 训练、生成、评估与统一入口
substeps: P4b: DiT batch preparation and training
tasks: Extract common runtime work from pilot/round runners; route all active entrypoints through molvid.
Keep codec and DiT training as two trainers; do not add joint training in this round.
Map optimizer parameter identities and resume state, retain gradient flow through a parameter-frozen decoder, and preserve corrected RMSF reading.
acceptance: One optimizer step and the next resumed step match the old reference.
Frozen parameters remain unchanged and required gradients reach the DiT/adapter.
Run a short observed-only generation/rollout and evaluate it independently.
CLI works from flat package imports; historical protocol-only configurations are not silently treated as runnable new architectures.

phases.title: 验证后切换与清理旧代码
tasks: Run retained targeted regression suite plus import isolation and a short CUDA profile; investigate material slowdown rather than adding CPU fallbacks.
Retire old paths only after extracted helpers, configuration callers and checkpoint needs have been accounted for.
Update README/current docs and package metadata; keep license/source notices and historical evidence intact.
Run package import checks outside the repository; only a separate explicit instruction permits publishing or remote pushes.
acceptance: All retained public classes live at their listed target paths; no src/ or molvid/models/ target packages.
Active imports/CLI/tests no longer depend on old root packages or PVB class aliases.
Numerical checks genuinely passed, or final numerical sign-off/cutover is explicitly withheld.
Current paths, preserved functionality, removed paths, commands and results are recorded concisely.

constraints: Inspect actual checkpoint wrappers before applying rules; model/module/EMA prefixes must be handled explicitly per format.
Verify tensor values, dtype, shape, shared parameter identity, unexpected/missing keys and key collisions; do not silently ignore unmatched weights.
Preserve optimizer moment state by parameter identity and param-group ordering; a freshly initialized optimizer is not a migrated resume state.
Preserve scheduler/scaler/RNG/sampler/counters and normalization artifacts; validate old hashes before conversion and write new outputs without overwriting originals.
Class/module renaming and state-dict attribute-key renaming are separate operations; do not rewrite tensor keys just because a Python import path changed.
For whole-object pickle checkpoints, export trusted local artifacts in their old commit environment first; do not keep old PVB aliases in the production package.
Existing clip stores may be adapted in memory at read boundaries; no full data rewrite for namespace renaming.

historical_reproduction.retired_algorithm_policy: History-only implementations remain reproducible at their original Git commit/environment; the flat main package is not required to support every historical runner or checkpoint architecture.
historical_reproduction.retained_artifact_policy: Current codec/encoder/DiT weights and statistics are mandatory migration targets. If an actual required checkpoint contradicts the planned retained components, record the conflict before deleting dependencies.

field_semantics.path: Repository-relative target file; all runtime files are inside root molvid/.
field_semantics.source: Previous baseline source locations or descriptions. Resolve actual symbols during P0; descriptions are not shell paths.
field_semantics.phase: First migration phase, not an assertion that implementation or tests have been completed.
field_semantics.classes_and_public_functions: Target responsibilities preserved from the previous design; not permission to create stubs or invent new science.
field_semantics.retirement_targets: Non-executable candidates; resolve callers and preserve evidence before retiring any path.
